primary_note: Within-condition Original/challenger Sol/native comparisons are full-cohort. Paired changes use those exact items; original-reference anchoring is a secondary diagnostic, not truth. Legacy helper field guided_agreement means the frozen challenger in this separate study.
repeat_note: Consistency is repeat agreement with the same Sol classifier, not semantic accuracy. Preselected subsets use n100 text/n25 photos, not the full primary denominator.
review_compute_note: Coding-harness qualitative review is outside the experiment API ledger; no claim of complete total research compute.
